instrument: Short-form Mandarin Chinese Demoralization Scale — oncology revised form
measured_domains: Existential Emptiness and Affective Distress (9); Self-Worth and Life Valuation (5); two subscales, not the parent 24-item five-factor model
validation_sample: 971 adults with solid tumours stages II–IV treated in two Hunan hospitals, ages 18–78; predominantly women (85%); convenience sample; not general community or all oncology cohorts.
respondent_languages: ZH-CN Mandarin respondent instrument is original SHORTENED 14-item Chinese form tested in Hunan province; not a translated new EN/RU/ES scale.
rights_and_commercial_use: Source article CC BY 4.0 does not settle rights for original demoralization items, electronic commercial administration, revised scoring, derivative translations or site interpretation. Obtain original scale and adaptation-owner clearances plus clinician oversight, safety response, confidentiality and crisis pathways.
safety_gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / CLINICIAN_ONLY. Parent DS-MV24 five factors and five-point scoring NOT interchangeable with this 14-item, two-factor, three-point form. Distress/meaning-to-live content requires licensed clinical review. Gender imbalance, same-sample EFA/Rasch and limited external validity; no cutoffs or question text exposed.

instrument: Simulated-Patient Consultation and Relational Empathy Measure — Spanish medical training
measured_domains: Patient-perceived clinician relational empathy (overall); emotional attunement/understanding (items 1–6 conceptually); cognitive-behavioral supportive response (items 7–10 conceptually); no independently established factor subscores
validation_sample: Simulated patients evaluate fourth-year medical students in Spanish clinical simulation, not psychiatric service users nor self-report by clinician; 8 simulated assessors, 270 interactions.
respondent_languages: No German-language respondent version demonstrated by German article translation.
rights_and_commercial_use: CC BY journal publication does not clear original CARE instrument item copyrights or commercial online simulation-use rights. Seek original CARE and Sp-CARE owners' permission, adapted 10 items, assessor training, scoring and cross-context rights. No item reuse.
safety_gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. One total score, dimensions descriptive not validated subscores; no CFA, small assessor pool, study-specific validity; don't substitute clinician self-assessment or psychotherapy alliance outcome.

instrument: Digital Numbing Scale — Italian original seven-item version
measured_domains: Digital numbing / tendency to use digital technologies to suppress uncomfortable emotions, thoughts and bodily experiences; single latent factor, not 4 distinct diagnostic subscales
validation_sample: Italian volunteer participants ages from 14, recruited online/social media, mixed genders; 3 convenience samples N394/N503/N557, not clinical diagnostic norms.
respondent_languages: IT-IT original adult/adolescent research administered to three Italian samples (N394, 503, 557), aged 14–72 or 14–70 depending on cohort.
rights_and_commercial_use: Taylor & Francis open access article does not by itself confirm rights for commercial site-hosted instrument administration, item/scorer reuse, translations, derivative copies or norms. Contact developer/rightsholder for explicit electronic commercial rights.
safety_gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Original IT-IT psychometrically studied, alpha .93; one-factor avoiding/numbing behavior, NOT substance-use diagnosis or digital addiction diagnostic threshold. Includes minors; protect privacy, obtain rights and follow consent safeguards. No items or scoring published.

instrument: Digital Numbing Scale — validated US English translated edition
measured_domains: Digital numbing, avoidant digital coping / suppression of inner experiences; one total factor (same as original Italian DNS-7)
validation_sample: US volunteer adults and older adolescents (17–79) recruited via online/social media; 213 respondents, non-probability sample.
respondent_languages: Original IT-IT tested in three independent Italian samples N394/503/557; separate paired source record; cross-country invariance examined.
rights_and_commercial_use: Written authorization for commercial digitally hosted questionnaire and scoring needed from developer and any original rights holder. Journal open-access status does not alone mean rights to SaaS instrument/derivative norms.
safety_gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. US English is a studied translated form, not a new psychometric instrument. Study is cross-sectional and non-clinical; no diagnostic norm/cutoffs; ages include 17-year-olds. No user-facing items, automated scores or production rollout.
